title: console: the import wizard, given a shipped CSV mapping, sends JSON rows that name the csv mapping and fails MAPPING_FORMAT_MISMATCH; the REST door with the same mapping succeeds
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-07** of track 1 (the full inventory pass), by the cloud tester `session_01RDJeRTLG52XkaPbYRvzLJf`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `b94cf856` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-full-pass-2026-10-20` at `f7297f63d`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it. The suspected landing below is the tester's reading. Paths under `src/`, `assets/` and `scripts/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL / steps:**
  - Manager and admin, on the lead, account and contact lists: Import → upload the first rows of `assets/import-templates/{leads,accounts,contacts}.csv` → Saved mapping "Lead / Account / Contact Import (CSV)" → Next → Import.
  - The shipped mapping is offered but not preselected.
- **Expected:** LEA-018, ACC-015 and ADM-004: a CSV upsert through the shipped mapping, with its synonym tables.
- **Actual:**
  - The console sends `{"format":"json","rows":[…]}` and the server answers `400 {"code":"MAPPING_FORMAT_MISMATCH","error":"Mapping \"crm_lead_import\" declares sourceFormat \"csv\" but the payload is \"json\""}`. Same for the account and contact mappings: 0 imported.
  - With manual mapping instead, the import inserts rather than upserts and rejects 2 of the template's 3 rows ("LinkedIn", "Google Ads" are not options; the synonyms live only in the mapping).
  - The REST door works: `POST /api/v1/data/crm_account/import {"format":"csv","mappingName":"crm_account_import","csv":…,"dryRun":true}` → 200, upsert, 2/2.
- **Evidence:** [`30-LEA-018-import-mapped.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/f7297f63d58f8c3e1b9b466ee241a05d3af9a5c8/qa/2026-10-20-full-pass/shots/30-LEA-018-import-mapped.png), [`30-LEA-018-shipped-step1.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/f7297f63d58f8c3e1b9b466ee241a05d3af9a5c8/qa/2026-10-20-full-pass/shots/30-LEA-018-shipped-step1.png), [`38-ACC-015-account-shipped-step1.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/f7297f63d58f8c3e1b9b466ee241a05d3af9a5c8/qa/2026-10-20-full-pass/shots/38-ACC-015-account-shipped-step1.png), [`38-ACC-015-contact-shipped-step1.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/f7297f63d58f8c3e1b9b466ee241a05d3af9a5c8/qa/2026-10-20-full-pass/shots/38-ACC-015-contact-shipped-step1.png).
- **class:** a. **reach:** the console import wizard.
- **Suspected landing spot:** the console (objectui) import wizard, which parses the file client-side and sends JSON rows while naming a csv mapping. Upstream. The app's mappings and templates are valid.
- **Dedupe words:** `MAPPING_FORMAT_MISMATCH`, `crm_lead_import`, `sourceFormat csv json`.
- **Known carrier:** #2060 item 17 (it asked to "measure first"). This answers it: the console door fails, the REST door succeeds.

## Dedupe

Method: all 4,852 objectui issues (every state), listed through `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues?state=all` and matched case-insensitively on their titles. The search API was rate-limited at filing time.
- `MAPPING_FORMAT_MISMATCH|sourceFormat|import.*mapping|saved mapping`: 6 hits, all closed. The nearest is objectui#10102 (closed 2026-09-22): the wizard never sent `mappingName` and hardcoded `writeMode:"insert"`. This card is what follows it: the name is sent now, but with client-parsed JSON rows. It also answers objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2060 item 17's "measure first": the console door fails, and the REST door works.
